name: Mighty Guard
description: Damage taken and dealt are reduced, while enmity is increased.

source_abilities.name: Mighty Guard
source_abilities.description:
Reduces damage taken by 40% while reducing damage dealt by 40%, increasing enmity generation, and preventing casting interruptions via damage taken.
Effect ends upon reuse.
